_comment: FRIC-total-accounting meta-gate policy (DATA, not code). Founder decision 2026-06-10: every friction-ledger row must terminate in a gate, an automation, or an explicit accepted-risk entry. This gate is the closed-loop accounting tracker for the friction ledger at ci/facade/action-item-accounting/friction-ledger.jsonl (moved off deleted .omc/ultragoal/; Google SRE postmortem action-item model: every action item must have an owner and verifiable closure). ALL repo-specifics live here; the Rust engine is neutral and runs on any repo by repointing ledger_path + status_taxonomy. See ADR-0544.

product_contract.born_pack_shaped: The ledger path, the free-text status taxonomy, the required-field set, and the evidence policy are DATA here; the Rust kernel hardcodes no repo path nor any oyatie string, so another repo adopts this gate by editing this policy. The kernel DOES fix the ledger ROW SCHEMA (the field names id/seen_at/status/status_update/friction/enforcement_fix/evidence and the primary-vs-update shape) — that schema is the engine's contract, not a per-repo pack value; an adopting repo maps its ledger to these field names.
product_contract.closed_loop: A friction is accounted iff it (a) has an anchoring primary row, (b) is schema-valid, (c) declares a disposition (enforcement_fix), and (d) when terminal/accepted-risk, cites its enforcement artifact via the evidence field. Mirrors the CLOSURE half of the Google SRE postmortem action-item model (verifiable closure). The OWNER half (per-row owner) and TIME-BOUND termination (aging) are NOT yet enforced here — see ADR-0544 known gaps.
product_contract.never_discourage_logging: Appending a friction row never fails the gate by itself. Only schema/disposition/closure/orphan violations on NEW rows block; legacy debt is baselined and may only shrink.
product_contract.status_match_tradeoff: status_match=prefix trades the fail-closed unknown-status forcing function for tolerance of the ledger's verbose vocabulary: a longest-prefix match means a new status sharing a registered prefix (e.g. open-*) classifies silently rather than tripping friction_unknown_status. Keep prefixes deliberately narrow; prefer exact entries where a class boundary must be precise.
product_contract.execution: Buck2-native Rust gate; no Cargo command is required for enforcement.

purpose: FRIC-total-accounting meta-gate. Every friction-ledger row must terminate in a gate, an automation, or an explicit accepted-risk entry; unconverted/undisposed/unevidenced frictions block merges like code debt.
